title: Tech Note: Format Data For Display in 4D Mobile
author: Xiang Liu, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: 4D Mobile (built on the bundled Wakanda server) was discontinued; native mobile app generation from 4D was dropped in favor of building web/mobile front-ends against ORDA-based REST APIs (and later Qodly), so the entire Wakanda-model-editor formatting workflow described here no longer exists in current 4D.
